messages:
Priya: Following last night's incident I sketched a short follow-up list — we need owners, deadlines, and a dashboard patch to track the recurring latency spikes on /v1/generate.

Jamal: thanks — can you paste the concrete action items?

Priya: sure. short list: 1) Update SLO to reflect 95th p95 target 220ms (was 200ms) while we stabilize; owner: Jamal; due: 2024-12-04. 2) Add prefix caching metric + dashboard panel; owner: Lucia; due: 2024-11-28. 3) Runbook: add playbook step for cache warm vs cold; owner: Morgan; due: 2024-11-21. 4) Error budget burn alert: threshold + paging policy; owner: Priya; due: 2024-11-25.

Lucia: noted for dashboard. I will add a panel showing p50/p95/p99 and a heatmap of per-model tail latency. will also add the prefix cache gauge.

Morgan: for runbook I want to add a quick troubleshooting checklist and an automated script to collect KV cache stats. snippet I plan to add:```bash
# gather kv cache sizes
rdw-cache-inspect --model all --output brief
```

Jamal: agree on temporary SLO shift while we roll out cache improvements. FYI we'll keep the error budget calc unchanged but add a separate SLA note for throughput under burst.

Priya: @Jamal can you call out exact SLA language? we need wording for customer-facing doc: "99.9% of requests under 3s, p95 under 220ms" — is that safe?

Jamal: phrasing suggestion: "Committed latency: p95 <= 220ms for standard requests; we maintain 99.9% request availability with graceful degradation policies." i'll draft.

oncall-bot: Incident #2024-11-19-17 closed by Jamal. Postmortem queued for review.

Lucia: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/latency/post-incident-2141 (wip). i'll tag panels: prefix_cache_gauge, p95_trend, per_model_tail. putting in a short description + threshold markers.

Priya: who can own the alert paging behavior (pager vs slack-only) for error-budget-burn? need to decide escalation.

Morgan: i can own that. propose: critical -> pager (SRE primary), high -> #eng-oncall slack + SRE oncall notify only if sustained 15m. i'll add to runbook and set alert tags.

Jamal: i'll update the SLO doc and submit the PR with the exact numbers and audit trail. PR ETA: 2024-11-20 EOD.

Priya: timeline summary: runbook (Morgan) 11/21, dashboard (Lucia) 11/28, SLO PR (Jamal) 11/20, error budget alert config (Priya+Morgan) 11/25. i'll put these into the postmortem action tracker and ping owners daily until closed.

Lucia: quick question — do we want a synthetic test to exercise prefix cache warm path? i can add a step to the dashboard that shows synthetic hit-rate.

Jamal: yes please. create a periodic job at low frequency that hits a small set of keys to validate warm hits, label as canary-cache-check.

Priya: perfect. i'll create the postmortem follow-up card and add the links to the PRs/dashboards and mark weekly check-ins until all actions are done.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: dashboard/latency-panels by Lucia -> staging. ETA 2024-11-22 03:00 UTC.

Priya: thanks team. i'll follow up tomorrow with the tracker link and a short weekly cadence invite. :thumbsup:
